{{Top|leg}}
'''Clotheslegging''' was an illicit [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] activity. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] tried their hands at the scheme in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]], with disastrous results.

==Behind the scenes==
The real-world practice of ''bootlegging'' involves smuggling alcohol.
